conflicts.description: Clause 6.7 establishes a non-waivable, unconditional payment duty for a transaction path, with severe penalties for downstream deviation. Clause 2.2 operates on the same path but acknowledges receiving a 'conditional' status, which it then converts to 'immediately operative.' This directly violates the mandate of 6.7. The conflict is exacerbated by clause 9.2, which forbids such status conversions, creating a three-way deadlock where any state of the payment obligation violates at least one clause and likely triggers default.
